overview.en: This rock-dwelling iguana is endemic to southwestern Madagascar.
overview.fr: Cet iguane rupicole est endémique du sud-ouest de Madagascar.

identification.en: It has a flattened body, fine keeled scales and a blue-grey back.
identification.fr: Son corps est aplati, ses écailles sont finement carénées et son dos bleu-gris.

habitat.en: It uses rocky or limestone outcrops and nearby thorn scrub.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les affleurements rocheux ou calcaires et les fourrés épineux voisins.

diet.en: The regional species account reports an insect diet.
diet.fr: La fiche régionale de l’espèce indique un régime insectivore.

reproduction.en: It lays eggs; a regional account reports clutches of four to six.
reproduction.fr: Il pond des œufs ; une fiche régionale signale des pontes de quatre à six.

ecology.en: The Reptile Database places it in arid southwestern Madagascar, including the Fiherenana and Onilahy valleys.
ecology.fr: Selon The Reptile Database, il vit dans les régions arides du sud-ouest malgache, notamment dans les vallées de la Fiherenana et de l’Onilahy.

conservation.en: A regional guide lists habitat loss and degradation as threats and reports Least Concern; this is not a new assessment.
conservation.fr: Un guide régional cite la perte et la dégradation de l’habitat et rapporte le statut « préoccupation mineure » ; il ne s’agit pas d’une nouvelle évaluation.

facts: Regional species account: endemic, diurnal, saxicolous; insect prey; four to six eggs; habitat threats.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

facts: Taxonomic record gives southwestern range and oviparity.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The inventory supplies no separate common name in either language. Conservation category and threat summary come from a regional guide; they are not a new population assessment.
review_note: Compared a Malagasy regional species account with The Reptile Database; kept claims brief and attributed the reported conservation category to the regional guide.
